content.comment_body: Hello, I created a website to access [product_name] [version_no], but it fails to connect during program loading. The IP address is detected, but I receive a connection error. However, using [product_name] the connection and loading work perfectly, so I'm unsure what the issue might be. Thanks.
Which version of [product_name] are you using?
Hi, I was using version [version_no], and after updating to [version_no], it works again. Thanks.

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered connection problems between their web app and [product_name] [version_no] when using [product_name]. Connection through the official software worked without issues, but their website couldn't connect to the device until upgrading [product_name] from [version_no] to [version_no] resolved it. The main usability concern is unreliable connectivity between custom web-based solutions and the hardware, even when the official software connects properly.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects reliable and consistent connections to [product_name] [version_no] from both their custom web applications and official software, regardless of [product_name] version.
